UNIVERSITY INSITITUTE OF PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES
UGC Centre of Advanced Study (CAS)
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH 160014 INDIA
(Established under the Panjab University Act VIII of 1947 enacted by the Govt. of India)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
23-01-2024
Recruitment of Project Research Scientist-I position in the University Institute of
Pharmaceutical Sciences (UIPS), Panjab University (PU), Chandigarh – 160014
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited from Indian nationals for the posts of Project Research Scientist-I to
work on an ICMR-sponsored project entitled ‘Investigations on the role of innate immune
response in neuroprotective effects of synthetic and natural heterosteroids on Alzheimer’s
disease pathogenesis and cognition’. The qualifications, emoluments and other details are
given below:
Duration: The duration of fellowship is for the period of one year and is extendable to three
years. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.
Fellowship Amount: Rs. 56,000 + HRA (18%) per month
Essential qualifications: (1) First-class postgraduate degree in Pharmaceutical Chemistry
including the integrated PG degree. (2) Second-class postgraduate degree in Pharmaceutical
chemistry, including the integrated PG degree with Ph.D.
Desirable qualifications: First class degree in M. Pharm (Pharmaceutical Chemistry)/M. S.
(Medicinal chemistry) with GATE/GPAT/CSIR-NET or equivalent qualifications. The
candidates should have a basic degree in pharmacy (B. Pharm) with first class.
Candidates passionate about research with skills and experience in synthetic medicinal
chemistry, molecular docking, animal handling would be preferred.
Age limit: 35 Years (relaxable for SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Female candidates as per the
GOI norms). All things being equal, SC/ST candidates will be preferred as per GOI rules.
Interested candidates are requested to send their applications in the attached format along with
CV via email to Principal Investigator, Prof. Ranju Bansal at ranju_bansal@pu.ac.in or
ranju29in@gmail.com before 8th February 2024. Please write “Application for Project
Research Scientist-I” in the subject line of the email. The shortlisted candidates will be
intimated by email and called for a personal interview. No TA/DA will be paid if called for an
interview.
General Instructions:
1. The PI has the discretion to restrict the number of candidates to be called for an interview to
a reasonable limit based on qualifications and experience higher than the minimum
prescribed in the advertisement.
2. Only shortlisted candidates will be communicated to appear in the interview and no other
communications in this regard will be entertained.
3. Original certificates and self-attested copies of all certificates need to be presented before
the interview for verification.
4. For any queries please contact: Prof. Ranju Bansal, University Institute of
Pharmaceutical Sciences, Panjab University (PU), Chandigarh-160014. Contact no:
+91 9876061147, E-mail: ranju_bansal@pu.ac.in, ranju29in@gmail.com
5. The application should be strictly according to the attached format.
Prof. Ranju Bansal
Principal Investigator
